name: WorldMap
label: World map
description: A flat world map from Natural Earth land shapes: token-coloured continents, framed bounds, and colour-carrying markers.

props.name: points
props.description: The places to mark. A point outside the framed view is simply not drawn.

props.name: bounds
props.description:
The window the map frames: `[west, south, east, north]` in degrees.
It must not cross the antimeridian. Defaults to the whole world
(Antarctica is not in the land data). Changing it resets any zoom.

props.name: fit
props.description:
How the framed window meets the container: `contain` letterboxes so the
whole window is visible, `cover` fills the container and crops the
window's edges — the full-bleed stage look.

props.name: showZoomControls
props.description:
Renders the zoom pill (zoom out, a percent readout that resets the
view, zoom in). Zoom steps into `bounds` and out past them — down to
the whole world with air around it, the graticule carrying on into
the space. Ctrl or ⌘ with the scroll wheel (a trackpad pinch) zooms at
the pointer; a plain scroll keeps scrolling the page. Dragging, or the
arrow keys with the map focused, moves the view anywhere on the world
at any zoom; a finger only drags while zoomed in, so the page keeps
its touch scroll too. Needs `interactive`.

props.name: maxZoom
props.description: How far the zoom controls can step in, as a multiple of `bounds`.

props.name: graticuleStep
props.description: Degrees between graticule lines. `0` removes the graticule.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Draw each point's `label` beside its marker.

props.name: activePointId
props.description: The point to single out: its marker enlarges and its callout renders.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Markers are real buttons: hoverable, focusable, clickable. Off, they become inert glyphs and the map is one image.

props.name: onPointHover
props.description: Fires as the pointer enters a marker (or it takes focus), and with `null` as it leaves.

props.name: onPointClick
props.description: Fires when a marker is clicked.

props.name: renderCallout
props.description:
Renders the annotation for the active (or hovered) point, placed beside
its marker in an HTML overlay; MapCallout is the intended filling. The
overlay carries `data-side="left"|"right"` for which side of the marker
it opens on — toward the map's centre, where the room is.

props.name: renderHoverCard
props.description:
Wraps each marker in the library's HoverCard, with this as the card's
content — the floating-panel alternative to `renderCallout`'s bare
readout, opening on hover or focus with the system's delays and Escape
dismissal. Content must be phrasing-level (spans), the panel's own
rule. Opens toward the map's centre, where the room is: downward from the upper half, upward from the lower.
Needs `interactive`; when both renderers are given, this one wins.

props.name: label
props.description:
Accessible name for the map, e.g. "Offices across the network". The
point count is appended for screen readers.

props.name: pointsLabel
props.description: The point count appended to the map's accessible name, given the count. Defaults to "<count> point" or "<count> points".

props.name: zoomHintLabel
props.description: The keyboard and pointer instructions appended to the map's accessible name while zooming is on.
props.default: Zoom with the controls or the plus and minus keys; drag or use the arrow keys to move the map.

props.name: zoomControlsLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the zoom toolbar. Defaults to "Map zoom controls".

props.name: zoomOutLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the zoom-out button. Defaults to "Zoom out".

props.name: zoomInLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the zoom-in button. Defaults to "Zoom in".

props.name: zoomResetLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the zoom readout that resets the view, given the zoom as a whole percentage. Defaults to "Zoom <percent>%. Reset the view".

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes
